infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: USEus uses the camera for the live game viewfinder, round clips, game photos and the flashlight.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: USEus uses the microphone for the noise meter in stealth games and to record sound in your clips. Audio never leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: USEus uses your location only during GPS Playzone rounds, to keep the game inside its boundary, and to name the place you play.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: USEus uses motion sensors to tell when you move in Red Light, the Weeping Statue and Floor Is Lava.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: USEus saves your round clips to your photo library when you choose Save.
